kitchen-ops: Preference: ceramic > reusables. Paper cups are OK for visitors but please put used paper in the small waste bin, not the compost. Also refill request: oat_creamer=low, sugar_packets=low.
pantry-bot: Inventory ping: oat_creamer=1 carton, sugar_packets=6, espresso_tin=open, mugs_clean=3. Low items flagged.

mike: :one: I can head out at 3:10. Add two oat_cream and mini biscotti.
anya: :two: busy then but can pick up napkins if needed.
felix: Also can we start a tiny "snack kitty" (optional) $3/mo? Vote :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no. Link: https://tiny.redwood/snack-kitty
kitchen-ops: I'll set out a clear jar for contributions and tape a note about it being optional. Please label items you bring.
mike: Sending $3 to Zoe via Venmo now for the creamer. Zoe  please keep receipt and drop in #finance-ops.
zoe: Got it. Ill grab the creamer and biscotti and bring bags for anyone who wants to split. Also ill reseal the espresso tin and put a sticky note "claimed by Anya" if it's hers.
anya: Thanks! will confirm after lunch.
